_comment: Controls what C2 (REDUCE) pulls out of the Geofabrik GPKG into the skinny DB. An override at /sdcard/Documents/GroupTrack/config/osm_layers.json takes precedence over this bundled copy; see OsmLayerCatalog.kt. Table names verified against arizona.gpkg 2026-07-28 -- the GPKG does NOT carry the _1 suffix the shapefile spec documents.

layers.label: Trails and tracks
layers._filter_comment: TRAILFILTER-2026-08-24K: path and bridleway REMOVED. path is OSM's 'narrow way, mode unspecified' and is overwhelmingly hiking trail; bridleway is equestrian. Together 16.5% of Arizona and 11.8% of Nevada, and neither is ground a SxS, UTV or Jeep can use. Measured against the raw .gpkg extracts, not assumed. NOTE: the access tags that would answer this properly (ohv, motor_vehicle, access) are NOT in Geofabrik's GeoPackage at all -- the roads layer has no access field of any kind -- so fclass answers by SHAPE, not by permission.
